title: Perishing by the account of being made
english: …to perish through the age — that is, to be perishable at every time, so far as the account of having been made reaches; if…
translator_notes: True OET from PG 70 Greek; Pass A ≠ Pass B.
Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify; skip Pusey-PD / Greystone / Lunn / Hill.
